description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to allow minor changes to the layout and elevations - additional windows to the office area to increase daylight and outlook, relocated entrance and additional cladding to the front elevation for security/safe by design, additional roof terrace to the existing building to provide additional staff amenity and relocated bike store to provide a safe route to the building following planning permission 00167/K/P16 dated 30/01/2020 for erection of a two storey factory/warehouse and office retaining part of the existing building following the demolition of most of the existing structures on site
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of planning permission 00167/K/P16 (30/01/2020)

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (7641_003 Rev. A; 7641_004 Rev. B; 7641_005 Rev. B; 7641_006 Rev. B; 7641_007 Rev. B; 7641_008 Rev. A;7641_009 Rev. A; 7641_010 Rev. A; 7641_011 Rev. A; 7641_012 Rev. A; (received on 31 March 2020); and Drainage / SUDS Maintenance Strategy (ref 218541) by Mason Navarro Pledge; Energy and Sustainability Assessment (ref 007740) Issue 1 by FES Group (received 27 September 2019); and Transport Statement (ref 18125-01) by Markides Associates Ltd (received on 08 November 2019) ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the materials and details submitted and approved under application 00167/K/P16(3-11) approved on 02 June 2020.
Condition : 4 - The building hereby approved shall be used only for factory/warehouse (B2/B8 use classes) without further approval from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The office floorspace contained within the development hereby approved shall be used only as offices ancillary to the main use of the premises as factory/warehouse (B2/B8) and shall not become a separate or dominant use at any time.
Condition : 6 - The hard and soft landscaping on the site shall be carried out in accordance the details approved under 00167/K/P16(3-11) approved on 02 June 2020.

Condition : 7 - During the course of the development:
a.	The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess any such additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.  
Before the development is first brought into use:
b.	The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clause a) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Condition : 8 - The provision of cycle parking shall be carried out in accordance the details approved under 00167/K/P16(3-11) approved on 02 June 2020.
The approved facilities shall be fully implemented and made available for use before the development is first occupied or brought into use and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.
Condition : 9 - The development shall be built in accordance with the details approved under 00167/K/P16(3-11) approved on 02 June 2020.

Condition : 10 - A) Within six months of work starting on site a BREEAM New Construction 2014 Shell and Core Design Stage certificate and summary score sheet (or such equivalent standard that replaces this) must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to show that an 'Excellent' (minimum score 70%) rating will be achieved.

B) Prior to first occupation of the building(s) a BREEAM New Construction 2014 Shell and Core Post-Construction Review certificate and summary score sheet (or such equivalent standard that replaces this) must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to show that an 'Excellent' (minimum score 70%) rating has been achieved.
Condition : 11 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the sustainable material details approved under 00167/K/P16(3-11) approved on 02 June 2020.
